name: Mongolostegus
sum: Mongolostegus is an Early Cretaceous stegosaur from Mongolia, the first stegosaur named from that country, known from a fragmentary specimen.
holotype: PIN 3779-15, a caudosacral vertebra with the first five caudal vertebrae, a sacral rib and pelvic bones — Dzunbain Formation, Chamrin-Us, Mongolia.
material: Holotype only; first included in a phylogeny in 2025 (Sánchez-Fenollosa and Cobos).
biology: Known only from the pelvic region; no biology is documented in the sources used.
author: Tumanova and Alifanov 2018

sources.text: Tumanova, T. A.; Alifanov, V. R. Dece. First Record of Stegosaur (Ornithischia, Dinosauria) from the Aptian–Albian of Mongolia. Paleontological Journal 52(14): 1771–1779. doi:10.1134/S0031030118140186
